payload.purpose_tldr: Strict boundary: forbidden legacy key nested in the payload.
payload.purpose_context: Full strict-profile envelope (all 14 keys) with the forbidden legacy key feature_slug buried inside the payload. The recursive forbidden-key walk must reject it even though the top-level key set is intact; MissionCreatedPayload (extra=forbid) independently reports the unknown field.

notes: FORBIDDEN_KEY comes from the recursive walker; PAYLOAD_SCHEMA_FAIL comes from the typed payload model's extra='forbid'. Both are deterministic collect-all outputs of validate_strict_envelope.
